messages:
marta: Heads up — customer ACME seeing SCIM bulk 403s after last night's KMS rotation. Error shows 'envelope header alias mismatch'. Anyone on rotations?
kevin: grabbing logs now. sample error: "unwrap failed tenant=acme user=svc-job-12 err=\"envelope header alias mismatch: expected ...redwood-svc-key-v2, got ...redwood-svc-key\""
ria: Rekeyer promoted redwood-svc-key-v2 at 2026-03-15T02:12Z. Looks like some provisioner nodes didn't pick up the new alias and still attempt unwrap against old alias. Also seeing a few JWE header rejects: 'unsupported header param typ'.
tara: Ops — can we pause SCIM deprovs for acme and throttle webhooks? I don't want auto-deprovs firing while unwraps fail.
ops-bot: Actioned: scim-deprov flag disabled for tenant=acme; webhook queue paused.
kevin: Short-term plan: 1) Re-add old alias as a grace/readonly alias for a short window 2) Run bounded unwrap backfill for affected users 3) Throttle unwrap retries to avoid KMS QPS spikes
ria: I exported affected list to /tmp/acme-unwrap-list.csv (approx 38 users). Will run backfill once alias is reintroduced. Staging run: 190/193 succeeded; 3 failed due to header.typ='JWT' in JWE.
marta: Good catch. We should add a pre-promote check in rekeyer to validate JWE header fields (typ allowed list) and add a 1-hour alias overlap window as a rollout policy.
tara: Re-added old alias with restricted policy + enabled replication. Also bumped provisioner logs to DEBUG for acme.
kevin: Running backfill now limited to 500 QPS. Posting results shortly.
kevin: Backfill finished: 35/38 restored; 3 require manual remediation due to non-standard JWE typ. I've exported them to /tmp/acme-manual-review.csv and flagged the support ticket.
marta: Thanks. We'll schedule a quick postmortem to capture rollout checklist updates: node config refresh, preflight JWE header validation, alias overlap policy, and a metric alert for unwrap failure spikes. Closing here once manual fixes done. :thumbsup:
